name: Pizzeria Cascata
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Cascata in Krimml**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Cascata** in the heart of **Krimml**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the breathtaking beauty of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from the stunning **Krimml Waterfalls**, this cozy spot offers delicious wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and a selection of fine wines and local beers.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or something more adventurous like a **Truffle Burrata**, our pizzas are made with the finest ingredients—all baked to perfection in our traditional stone oven.

After your meal, take a moment to relax with a **Tiramisu** or a warm **Espresso** while enjoying the mountain views. **Pizzeria Cascata** is the perfect place to unwind after a day of exploring **Krimml’s** natural wonders or hiking through the **Hohe Tauern Nationalpark**.

Come visit us and experience the perfect blend of Italian passion and **Tirol** charm!
